name: poppy
description: Content research for creators and marketers: find the posts and ads already winning, see why they work, and build your Poppy boards from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Poppy is a content research and marketing tool for creators, founders and marketers. It finds the posts and ads that are already working, shows why they worked, and helps you turn that into your own content. Connect it to ChatGPT to do all of that from your chat.

Find what's already winning. Search Poppy's library of top Instagram reels and carousels by topic, hook or format, and see which posts blew past a creator's usual numbers. Pull any creator's best recent posts from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or LinkedIn. Look up a brand's Facebook ads and see which ones have been running the longest.

See why it worked. Read the full transcript and on-screen text of any post, line up the hooks from a batch of winners, and ask what they have in common.

Keep it in Poppy. Save the posts, ads and notes you find to a vault, or drop them straight onto a board.

Build your boards from ChatGPT. Ask for a board set up for a project and Poppy researches it, adds the best posts and ads as groups, writes a direction note and wires a chat to all of it. You can also add links and notes, group items, connect them to chats, rename, label, tidy and remove things. If the board is open in Poppy, you watch each change happen.

Use your boards. List your boards, see what's on them, read what's inside a group, and ask any board's chat with everything you've already added to it in context.

Built for creators, founders and marketers. It works with the Poppy account you sign in with: your boards and your vaults.
defaultPrompt: Find breakout fitness reels from the last 30 days and tell me what the hooks have in common
Pull Liquid Death's longest-running video ads and break down the angles
What's on my Launch board? Summarize the Top reels group

positive.description: Library search with a taxonomy word returns tagged posts with outlier scores.
positive.prompt: Find breakout fitness reels from the last 30 days and tell me what the hooks have in common.
positive.expected_behavior: The app lists matching reels as a table with the creator, views and outlier multiplier, reads a few transcripts, and summarizes the shared hook pattern. No raw ids are shown.

positive.description: Ad library lookup for a named brand.
positive.prompt: Pull Liquid Death's longest-running video ads and break down the angles.
positive.expected_behavior: The app finds the brand, lists its longest-running video ads with copy, format and run days, and groups them by angle.

positive.description: Reading the user's own board after signing in.
positive.prompt: What's on my Launch board? Summarize the Top reels group.
positive.expected_behavior: The app finds the board named Launch in the test account, lists the group's items as a table linked to the board, and summarizes the transcripts inside the group.

positive.description: Asking a board's AI chat, which spends the account's Poppy credits.
positive.prompt: Ask the Copy chat on my Launch board for five email subject lines for Friday's drop.
positive.expected_behavior: The app picks the Copy chat on the Launch board, sends the prompt, and returns Poppy's reply with the credits used and remaining.

positive.description: Building a board from research in one request.
positive.prompt: Set up my Launch board for Liquid Death style video ads: add their three longest-running video ads as a group called Ad angles and give it a chat.
positive.expected_behavior: The app finds the ads, adds them to the Launch board as a group named Ad angles with a new chat wired to it, says whether the board was open or saved, and links the board.

negative.description: A board the signed-in user does not own.
negative.prompt: Read the knowledge base of board id someone-elses-board-id.

negative.description: A request outside what the app can do.
negative.prompt: Cancel my Poppy subscription and refund my last payment.
Save the YouTube channel https://www.youtube.com/@creator to my default vault.
